LoRA rank is a budget most adapters never spend.\
\
What if we trained them to use it?\
\
Our paper closes the gap between configured & effective rank with one loss term.\
\
Adapters that use their rank forget less, at little cost to learning.\
\
Paper: https://t.co/erlRuzok86 https://t.co/RfZCSPcdfy
The tokenization survey is finally out!!!

🚨 [Token][ization] Paper Alert 🚨\
\
Tokenization is a wildly understudied area of language modeling despite it having effects across all of NLP. Over the past ~8 months, 32 (!) tokenizer researchers put together the most comprehensive survey of the field. Check it out! https://t.co/l8ckiH5oUT
I will be at #EMNLP2025 ! DM me if you want to grab coffee!! 😊

BPE merge lists in LLMs are a privacy risk. What if we just ignored them at inference?\
\
Our paper shows you can ditch the merge list without retraining. Merge-list-free tokenization has minimal impact on performance & can even improve it on some tasks.\
\
Paper: https://t.co/sobiFGJD1R

Why do we evaluate LLMs using multiple-choice QA...\
...when in practice, we ask them to generate open-ended answers?\
Standard evaluation rewards models for choosing the right letter — not for reasoning their way to an answer.\
A better alternative: Cascaded Information Disclosure
